Admin

Global settings

Settings for the whole instance: registration, fetching, retention, AI, traffic, legal pages and email.

Legal pages incomplete - Fill in Operator name, Contact email, and Jurisdiction below before opening registration to users.

Users

Allow new users to register without invitation

A feed stops being fetched once none of its readers has used Readfine for this long, and starts again when one comes back. Admins and accounts with a briefing never pause. Without the warning email, nobody is told beforehand. Empty = off, at least 30.

With this on, nobody's feeds pause without an email first.

PUBLIC_URL is not set, so the email goes out without a link to sign in. Set it in .env and restart.

Feed fetching

Startup baseline for Auto feeds: used until a feed has ~7 days of history to learn its publish rate from

No feed is fetched more often than this; also floors manual per-feed intervals. Auto mode has its own floor of 30 min, so its effective minimum is the higher of the two, set this above 30 and Auto follows.

Cap for the adaptive interval on quiet feeds

Retention

Older articles are removed; ones you engaged with are kept as profile stubs

AI

AI summaries and other AI-powered features

Traffic

Aggregated counts for the landing, sign-in and info pages, shown under Traffic . Signed-in traffic is not counted. Nothing per-visit is stored: no IP address, no user agent, no cookie, no third party. A new account keeps the domain that sent it; switching this off removes that from every account, for good.

With registration closed there is no landing page to count: / sends visitors straight to sign-in. Sign-in, features, help, privacy and terms are still counted, and so are visits to /register , which on an invite-only instance is people finding the door locked.

Legal pages

Shown on /terms and /privacy . "Last updated" date is set automatically on save.

SMTP (email)

Password saved

Plain address, or with a display name shown in inboxes:
Readfine <noreply@readfine.app>

STARTTLS. Port 465 always uses implicit TLS instead.

Test connection

Show a "Send feedback" item in the user menu. Messages are emailed to admins via SMTP above, so it requires SMTP to be configured.

Let users add extra recipients to their scheduled briefings. Those addresses never confirm anything and the user's own prompt shapes the text, so on an instance open to registration this lets anyone send mail from your domain. Admins can always add them.
